package polarity

import (
	"net/http"
	"slices"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type Handlers struct{}

func teamFigure() []int { return []int{2} }

// thinGroups is a planted floor: true where a group is too small to show.
func thinGroups(groups [][]string) []bool { return make([]bool, len(groups)) }

// The switch is off on this branch, and it hands out the team's figure.
func (h Handlers) GetTheTeamWhileOff(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if allowed, _ := auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context()); !allowed {
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigure())
		return
	}
	httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
}

func (h Handlers) GetTheTeamUnlessOff(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if allowed, _ := auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context()); !allowed {
		httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigure())
}

// While the switch is off, the team's figure passes the floor first.
func (h Handlers) GetTheTeamOrTheFloor(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if allowed, _ := auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context()); allowed {
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigure())
		return
	}
	if slices.Contains(thinGroups([][]string{{"a", "b"}}), true) {
		httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigure())
}

func (h Handlers) GetPastTheFloor(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	thin := thinGroups([][]string{{"a", "b"}})
	if thin[0] {
		httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigure())
}

// The floor said the group is too small, and the figure goes out anyway.
func (h Handlers) GetInsideTheFloor(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	thin := thinGroups([][]string{{"a"}})
	if thin[0] {
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigure())
		return
	}
	httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
}

// A figure-free call after an unchecked figure does not make it figure-free.
func (h Handlers) GetAFigureThenTheCatalog(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	figures := teamFigure()
	auth.Catalog()
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, figures)
}

// Nor does it cover a figure in the response itself, or one worked out from a
// figure held before it.
func (h Handlers) GetTheCatalogThenALiteral(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth.Catalog()
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{42})
}

func (h Handlers) GetTheCatalogThenArithmetic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	figures := teamFigure()
	auth.Catalog()
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, figures[0]*2)
}

// What is worked out from the catalog alone is figure-free.
func (h Handlers) GetTheCatalogCounted(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	names := auth.Catalog()
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"names": names, "count": len(names)})
}
